name: run_sql
purpose: Measure September 2026 distinct active users under standard session activity and cross-check against users with a content view.
query: SELECT 'sessions' AS activity_source, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS active_days, MIN(date) AS first_date, MAX(date) AS last_date FROM sessions WHERE date >= '2026-09-01' AND date < '2026-10-01' UNION ALL SELECT 'views', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT user_id), COUNT(DISTINCT date), MIN(date), MAX(date) FROM content_views WHERE date >= '2026-09-01' AND date < '2026-10-01'

name: run_sql
purpose: Quantify the difference between session- and view-based September activity and validate that active session IDs correspond to user records.
query: WITH s AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM sessions WHERE date >= '2026-09-01' AND date < '2026-10-01'), v AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM content_views WHERE date >= '2026-09-01' AND date < '2026-10-01') SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s) AS session_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v) AS view_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s JOIN v USING (user_id)) AS both_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s LEFT JOIN v USING (user_id) WHERE v.user_id IS NULL) AS sessions_only, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v LEFT JOIN s USING (user_id) WHERE s.user_id IS NULL) AS views_only, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s LEFT JOIN users USING (user_id) WHERE users.user_id IS NULL) AS session_users_missing_user_record

name: update_hypotheses

hypotheses.statement: September MAU using the standard definition of at least one recorded session is 5,473 unique users.
hypotheses.evidence: September 1–30 sessions have 40,252 rows and 5,473 distinct users; all session-active IDs match a user record.

hypotheses.statement: Session-based and content-view-based activity counts differ materially because some active users did not record a view or had views without a session.
hypotheses.evidence: Of 5,473 session-active users, 5,178 also had a view and 295 had sessions only; there were zero view-only users.

next_step: Report September 2026 MAU using session activity, explicitly state the date window and note the lower view-based alternative for definition clarity.

answer:
## Answer
September 2026 MAU was **5,473 users**, counting each user with at least one recorded session during the month.

## Definition and scope
MAU is the number of distinct users with a session from **September 1 through September 30, 2026**, inclusive.

## Data quality
All 5,473 session-active user IDs matched a user record. A view-based definition would give **5,178 users**; those users were all also in the session-based count.
